papers.title: Effect of laser powder bed fusion parameters on the microstructural evolution and hardness of 316L stainless steel

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Lassonde School of Engineering, York University, Toronto, ON, Canada

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅涉及316L不锈钢的LPBF工艺参数与硬度，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳等生物医学植入物关键问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous implant design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration, and lacks any biomedical context or validation for implant applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索LPBF参数对316L不锈钢微观组织和硬度的影响规律
summary_zh.method: 改变激光功率、扫描速度等参数制备试样并进行表征分析
summary_zh.result: 发现优化的参数组合可获得高硬度且致密的微观结构
summary_zh.validation: 通过硬度测试和微观组织观察验证参数-性能关系

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of laser powder bed fusion process parameters on the microstructural evolution and hardness of 316L stainless steel.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated with varying laser power, scan speed, and other parameters, followed by microstructural characterization and hardness testing.
summary_en.result: Optimal parameter combinations were identified that yield high hardness and dense microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Experimental hardness measurements and microstructural analysis were used to validate the parameter-property relationships.

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate long-term functional outcomes and metal ion levels in patients with ceramic-on-metal total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A cohort of patients underwent clinical and radiographic follow-up at 9 years, with measurement of serum metal ion concentrations.
summary_en.result: High implant survival rates were observed, metal ion levels remained within safe limits, and functional outcomes were satisfactory.
summary_en.validation: Clinical and radiographic data from a longitudinal cohort study.

papers.title: Anterolateral Bone Window for Revision Broken Cemented Stem of Unipolar Hemiarthroplasty
papers.abstract: Background. Fractured stem of the hip prosthesis is well documented in the literature. Although it is rare, it is considered as a challenging problem. Many techniques have been described to solve this problem. Purpose of the Study. Evaluation of the effect of anterolateral bone window for extraction of the cemented femoral stem of hemiarthroplasty in revision total hip replacement. Methods. The study included eight revision hip arthroplasties in eight patients, with a broken stem of cemented (Thompson) hemiarthroplasty, which has been revised by the anterolateral proximal femoral window. All cases received cemented cups and cement-in-cement stems, except one case who received cementless long stem. Clinical follow-up of cases by Harries hip score (HHS) and X-ray. Results. Functional improvement of HHS of all cases, with no signs of loosening, after a mean follow-up period of 1.5 years. Conclusion. Extraction of broken stem is a challenging procedure. Many techniques have been described for revision of cases with a fractured stem of hip prosthesis, but we think that the anterolateral femoral bone window is a reproducible technique due to the characteristics of simplicity, short-time procedure, less invasive, not requiring extra instruments, and can be successful for most patients.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文为临床手术技术报道，未涉及任何生物力学分析，与研究方向的股骨应力遮挡和有限元建模完全无关。

summary_zh.motivation: 评估前外侧骨窗技术取出断裂骨水泥柄的效果
summary_zh.method: 对8例翻修患者采用前外侧股骨窗技术取出断裂柄
summary_zh.result: Harris髋关节评分改善，无松动迹象

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the clinical effectiveness of an anterolateral femoral bone window for extracting a fractured cemented stem in revision hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Eight revision cases with broken Thompson stems were treated using the anterolateral proximal femoral window technique, followed by cemented cup and cement-in-cement stem placement.
summary_en.result: Functional improvement was observed via Harris Hip Score with no signs of loosening at a mean follow-up of 1.5 years.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up with Harris Hip Score and radiographic assessment.
